summary.name: Memo
summary.one_liner: Memo is a sticky notes app for macOS that creates, organizes and syncs notes across devices through iCloud, with Markdown support and attachments.
use_cases: keep quick sticky notes on a Mac desktop
sync notes between Mac and other Apple devices
attach files and images to notes
lock confidential notes with a password or Touch ID
see notes on the home or lock screen via widgets
summary.what_it_does:
Memo lets users create and organize notes with colors, fonts and backgrounds, and group them using folders, tags or categories. It supports Markdown formatting for headings, lists and links, and lets users attach files, images and other media to notes. Notes sync automatically across devices signed into the same iCloud account. Widgets show notes on the home or lock screen, and notes can be protected with a passcode or Touch ID. The page also lists dark mode, multi-monitor support, M1 optimization and interface languages including English, French, German, Japanese and Chinese.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Syncs notes across devices via iCloud
Touch ID or passcode protection for notes
Widgets for home and lock screen
caveats: Requires an iCloud account for syncing
